review_locator: PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes; PMCID:PMC3760105, Immune Privilege as an Intrinsic CNS Property of the Central Nervous System
primary_title: Interleukin-1beta induces blood-brain barrier disruption by downregulating Sonic hedgehog in astrocytes
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-1beta as an astrocyte inflammatory chemokine inducer; the cited primary reports increased astrocytic CXCL2/MIP-2 protein after IL-1beta, alongside CCL2 and CCL20, with BBB-disruption and immune-cell-migration readouts.
limitations_preserved: Secreted inflammatory chemokine-output bridge; preserve mouse astrocyte/BBB context, distinguish CXCL2 protein release from CXCL2 gene induction and later CXCR2 activation, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting.

primary_title: Interleukin-1beta induces blood-brain barrier disruption by downregulating Sonic hedgehog in astrocytes
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-1beta as a mediator of astrocyte BBB dysfunction; the cited primary demonstrates IL-1beta suppression of astrocytic Sonic hedgehog production and loss of astrocyte-conditioned-media BBB protection, with SHH agonist rescue semantics.
limitations_preserved: Suppressive protective-mediator bridge; preserve astrocyte/BBB and SHH-agonist rescue context, keep SHH production distinct from later PTCH1/SMO signaling, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting.
